statements.statement: CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered
Patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
Symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
Patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The monitoring is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
Extended mobile telemetry is the appropriate means of documenting the arrhythmia
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
